title: Upgrade to v1.24.0 (Security hardening: never-halt invariant, validator mint isolation, award cost cap, cancel-unbonding ante rule)
summary: Hardens BeginBlock / EndBlock / MintIfNeeded / GetParams so runtime state-write or read failures are logged and the chain continues instead of halting. Isolates per-validator mint distribution so an invalid validator operator address or a failed send/burn on one recipient never blocks minting for the rest (supply is kept neutral via burn of the skipped share, with stuck-in-module accounting if burn also fails). Adds an upper bound of 1,000,000 MIRAGE to AwardConfig.Cost in params validation. Extends DisableDelegatorStakingDecorator to reject MsgCancelUnbondingDelegation from non-self accounts (same rule as MsgUndelegate). No on-chain state migration and no new store keys.
